say:2:1810620001:0.text: I can't believe it... Miss Tephesia's succession ceremony is finally happening!
say:2:1810620001:0.source_cn: 终于……终于要为苔佩希小姐举行继任仪式了！

say:3:1810620002:0.text: Wait, no. I should be calling her Lady Tephesia now.
say:3:1810620002:0.source_cn: 不，不对。现在该称苔佩希阁下了。

say:4:1810620003:0.text: Why are you so excited? Whether she succeeds or not changes nothing for servants like us. She's always been our master.
say:4:1810620003:0.source_cn: 你为什么这么兴奋？对于你我这样的仆人而言，无论她是否继...

say:5:1810620004:1.text: But there's a grand ball after the ceremony! The castle only gets this lively once every few decades, maybe even centuries!
say:5:1810620004:1.source_cn: 可是继任仪式之后有舞会啊，盛大的舞会！城堡里几十年，甚...

say:6:1810620005:1.text: And I wasn't assigned to wait on anyone this time. Maybe I can find a quiet corner and enjoy the festivities for once... Do you know of any good spots?
say:6:1810620005:1.source_cn: 刚好这次舞会没有安排我去服侍，也许我也该找个角落享受一...

say:7:1810620006:1.text: Hmm. You'll want to stay close to the grand hall.
say:7:1810620006:1.source_cn: 享受舞会的氛围啊……那肯定要待在大厅附近。

say:8:1810620007:1.text: How about the <style="highlight">Bloodbat Chandelier</style> in the center of the hall? If you <style="highlight">trigger the mechanism and spread its wings</style>, you can climb up from either staircase without the guests noticing you.

say:9:1810620008:1.text: Ooh, that actually sounds like a wonderful idea. I think I'll try that.
say:9:1810620008:1.source_cn: 唔，果然是个不错的主意……我会试试看的。

say:10:1810620009:1.text: The illusions fall silent. A few moments later, the conversation loops from the beginning.
say:10:1810620009:1.source_cn: 两个幻象陷入了沉默。片刻之后，对话又从头开始。

say:13:1810620010:0.text: According to them, the chandelier isn't just for decoration. It can somehow connect the staircases on both sides.
say:13:1810620010:0.source_cn: 听他们的说法，大厅中央的吊灯不仅可以行走，似乎还能连通...

say:14:1810620011:1.text: Perhaps we can use that mechanism to cross over to the other side.
say:14:1810620011:1.source_cn: 或许我们也能通过幻象中提及的机关去到另一侧。
